name: voice.list
title: List voices (any voice provider)
summary: List the voices one voice provider can speak with, as {id, name} plus whatever else the provider knows. Pass an id as voice to voice.speak with the same provider.
description: Submit {"tool": "voice.list", "input": {"provider": "piper"}}. Piper lists the installed voice files; ElevenLabs asks the API and, when the key may not list voices (a text-to-speech-only key), returns the built-in catalogue of premade voices with a warning.

provider.description: Which provider's voices: piper, elevenlabs, or a provider an extension adds.

search.description: Keep only voices whose id, name or labels contain this text (case-insensitive).

id.description: Pass this as voice to voice.speak.

name.description: A human name for the voice.

language.description: Language code when known, e.g. en_US.

labels.description: Provider labels such as gender, accent or use.

warnings.description: For example: the list is a catalogue because the key may not read voices.
